# Wallet Address Validator Kit

Canonical source: https://github.com/OathWallet/wallet-address-validator-kit

Install:

```bash
npm install github:OathWallet/wallet-address-validator-kit#0.2.1
```

CLI:

```bash
walletaddrcheck address <address> --chain bitcoin --pretty
```

API:

```js
import { validateAddress } from "wallet-address-validator-kit";
validateAddress("1BoatSLRHtKNngkdXEeobR76b53LETtpyT", { chain: "bitcoin" });
```
